name: WhatsLink Click Tracker
author: WPSani

sections.description:
Most WordPress websites use WhatsApp as a black box.

You receive conversations — but you don’t know:
* Which page generated them
* Which campaign drove the click
* Which UTM source converted
* Which content performs best

WhatsLink Click Tracker gives you full visibility into your WhatsApp performance directly inside WordPress.

It works with both:
* https://wa.me/
* https://api.whatsapp.com/send

Perfect for store owners, marketers, agencies, and support teams that rely on WhatsApp for leads and sales.

✅ What you can do with WhatsLink

  • See which pages generate WhatsApp clicks
  • Measure content performance
  • Track UTM campaigns (Pro)
  • Analyze trends over time (Pro)
  • Export click data (Pro)
  • Receive real-time email notifications (Pro)
  • Display click counters directly on your links (Free)

🚀 Free Version Features

  • Detects clicks on all WhatsApp links
  • Works on posts, pages, and WooCommerce products
  • Tracks:
    • Post title
    • Post type
    • Permalink
    • Click date & time
    • Clicked URL
  • AJAX-powered dashboard
  • Pagination and live search
  • Sortable columns
  • One-click log reset
  • Lightweight and optimized
  • GDPR-friendly (no IP or location tracking)
  • Optional badge counter showing total clicks next to each WhatsApp link on the page

The badge counter lets you instantly see which buttons are performing — without opening the dashboard.

🔐 Pro Version – Advanced WhatsApp Analytics

Upgrade to WhatsLink Click Tracker Pro and unlock full campaign-level insights.

Campaign & Attribution Tracking

  • Tracks utm_source
  • Tracks utm_medium
  • Tracks utm_campaign
  • Tracks referrer

Know exactly which traffic sources generate conversations.

Advanced Reporting Dashboard

The Pro Reports section includes:

  • Date range filtering
  • Filter by post type
  • Filter by permalink
  • Filter by UTM parameters
  • KPI overview (total clicks, top sources, top URLs)
  • Trend chart over time
  • Top Sources chart
  • Top Mediums chart
  • Top Campaigns chart
  • Top Pages chart
  • Top Clicked URLs chart

Built with interactive visual charts for quick analysis.

Automation & Export

  • Export click logs to CSV
  • Receive real-time click notifications via email
  • Daily summary reports
  • Weekly summary reports

Ideal for agencies and performance marketers.

👉 Unlock Pro features

🔒 Privacy / GDPR

WhatsLink Click Tracker is built with privacy in mind.

Free version logs:
* Post / page / product title
* Post type
* Permalink
* Click date and time
* Clicked URL

Free version does NOT collect:
* IP addresses
* Country or geolocation data
* Personal user data

If Pro is activated, additional tracking fields such as UTM parameters and referrer may be logged.

Always ensure your privacy policy reflects the tools used on your website.

Features

✅ FREE VERSION

  • Detects clicks on all WhatsApp links
  • Works on posts, pages, and WooCommerce products
  • Tracks post_title, permalink, clicked_url, datetime
  • AJAX dashboard with pagination and search
  • Column sorting by title, date, and type
  • Optional badge counter on WhatsApp links
  • Lightweight and fast
  • GDPR-friendly: no IP or location tracking

🔐 PRO VERSION

  • Tracks utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign
  • Tracks referrer
  • Advanced report filters (date, permalink, post type, UTM)
  • KPI overview dashboard
  • Trend chart over time
  • Top Sources chart
  • Top Mediums chart
  • Top Campaigns chart
  • Top Pages chart
  • Top Clicked URLs chart
  • Export logs to CSV
  • Real-time email notifications
  • Daily & weekly reports
  • Priority support

👉 Unlock Pro features
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/whatslink-click-tracker or install directly via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Tools → WhatsLink Click Tracker to view logs.
sections.faq:
Does it track all WhatsApp links?

Yes. It detects both https://wa.me/ and https://api.whatsapp.com/send.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes. WhatsApp clicks on product pages are tracked.

Is it GDPR compliant?

The Free version does not store IP addresses or geolocation data.

Can I export logs?

CSV export and email reports are available in the Pro version.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Logging is asynchronous and optimized for performance.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

FREE

  • Added badge counter on WhatsApp links showing total clicks per link.
  • Added new column: Clicked URL.
  • Refactored click count logic into a dedicated module.
  • Improved logging reliability with sendBeacon.
  • Security improvements.

PRO

  • Added advanced report filters (date range, post type, permalink, UTM).
  • Added KPI overview in Reports.
  • Added Trend chart.
  • Added Top Sources, Mediums, Campaigns, Pages and Clicked URLs charts.
  • Internal improvements and compatibility updates.

1.0.1

  • Security and stability improvements.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
